title: Confidence calibration artefact
description: Model-bound confidence-calibration artefact for the strum and chord recognition bands (E14-R21/E14-R32, ADR 0536/0540). Fitted by ml/honest_eval.py::section_calib on a HELD-OUT fold and emitted by CI (ml-train.yml sections=calib / chord-train.yml); read in the app by lib/features/live/domain/evaluation/confidence_calibration_profile.dart, whose hand-written parser is the enforcing implementation (ADR 0354 D8 precedent: no schema-library dependency). NO artefact ships today — every prediction's calibratedConfidence stays null until a held-out fit exists (ADR 0536 D1). The in-sample knots in lib/features/live/engine/ml/live_crnn_classifier.dart::calibrate are deliberately NOT promoted into this format: they were fitted on the same fold their accuracy was reported on.

schemaVersion.description: Artefact schema contract version. Any other value is a typed CalibrationConfigException (unknownSchemaVersion), never a fall-back to a default mapping.

artefactVersion.description: This artefact's own version, e.g. strum-live3c-heldout-v1. Changes whenever the numbers change.

band.description: Which recognition band this artefact calibrates. An artefact served to the other band is refused (CalibrationUnavailableReason.bandMismatch).

model.description: The weights this calibration belongs to. Both fields are compared verbatim at every call: a matching id with a different sha256 is a mismatch, and the calibrated confidence is withheld (fail-closed, ADR 0536 D4).

modelId.description: Model identifier as used by assets/ml/model_manifest.json, e.g. strum_crnn_live_3c.

modelSha256.description: SHA-256 of the weight blob the calibration was fitted against.

provenance.description: Where the numbers came from. Every field is required and non-empty: an artefact that cannot say which corpus and which fold produced it is not evidence.

corpusId.description: Corpus identifier, e.g. klangio-live70 or guitarset-majmin.

corpusSha256.description: Corpus content hash, matching the corpus manifest's corpusSha256. No raw audio is ever committed (ADR 0354 D1) — only this hash.

foldId.description: The fold inside that corpus the mapping was fitted on, e.g. logo-fold-3 or split3way-seed42-val.

sampling.description: heldOut: the fitting fold is disjoint from the fold the accuracy was reported on. inSample: it is not — representable so the legacy state can be described honestly, but NEVER served (CalibrationUnavailableReason.inSampleArtefact).

observationCount.description: Labelled observations the mapping was fitted on. 0 is a schema violation, not a measurement of nothing.

fittedAtCommit.description: Repository commit the fitting script ran at.

producedBy.description: The workflow/command that emitted the artefact, e.g. 'ml-train.yml sections=calib'.

perClassMappings.description: Chord band only: per-class overrides of the default mapping, keyed '<root>:<quality>' (e.g. 'A:min'). A strum artefact carrying this key is rejected. Absent or empty means the default mapping applies to every class — the honest state until per-class support is measured.

mapping.description: A monotone confidence mapping. Both families are total on 0..1 and non-decreasing, so a higher raw score can never map to a lower calibrated confidence.

kind.description: identity: calibrated == raw, a declarable measured state (never an implicit fallback for a missing artefact). piecewiseLinear: interpolate between knots, clamped at both ends (never extrapolated).

knots.description: Required for piecewiseLinear, forbidden for identity. raw must be strictly increasing; calibrated must be non-decreasing.

raw.description: Raw model confidence (max softmax / winning similarity).

calibrated.description: Empirical P(correct) measured on the held-out fold at this raw confidence.
